'''Selko''' was a [[human]]<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Welcome Rebellion AD" /> affiliated with the [[Bail Organa's resistance movement|resistance movement]] led by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]], a member of the [[Imperial Senate]]. Organa had him and two other agents, [[Beska]] and [[Charval]], ensure the [[Escape from the Senate|safe extraction]] of Senator [[Mon Mothma]] off the [[Imperial Senate Building]] and [[Coruscant]], unaware that Beska was an operative for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" /> At the Senate Building entrance, Selko lackadaisically made his way through the security gate.<ref name="Welcome Rebellion AD" /> After Mothma's speech about the [[Ghorman Massacre]], Beska attempted to arrest her while drawing a [[blaster]]. In response, a confused Selko asked Beska what she was doing. Beska informed Selko, Mothma, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], and everyone else in the room that she was taking Mothma into custody in an ISB arrest.<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" />

However, Andor [[Death|killed]] the double agent with a shot to the head with [[Clem's blaster pistol|his blaster]], after she was distracted by [[Erskin Semaj]] calling her a "Rebel Spy." Erskin grabbed Beska's blaster and aimed it at Selko, who raised his [[Limb|hands]] in panic. Meanwhile, Andor also directed his attention to Selko asking the agent for his identity. A panicked Selko shook his head and said he was no one and just met Beska, while keeping his hands up. At blasterpoint, Andor instructed Selko to get on the floor. After trying to reason with Andor, Selko complied, allowing Mothma to escape with Andor guarding her.<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Selko was a human male with [[Color|dark]] curly [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s and dark skin.<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" />

==Equipment==
Selko carried a shoulder bag draped over his right shoulder.<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selko first appeared in "[[Welcome to the Rebellion]]", the ninth episode of [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. He was portrayed by [[Akshay Khanna]].<ref name="Welcome Rebellion" />
